description: Subscribed event delivery, daemon to plugin, fire-and-forget: params.topic string + params.payload (any JSON, may be null); no id; dropped silently without the observe capability or a matching subscription. Also records the only other implemented notification, rpc.disconnect
source: BBB_V2_AUDIT.md sections 6.6-7; rpc.c:921-996; bbb_client.c:864-899, 1616-1667; BBB_PROTOCOL_DESIGN.md section 5
checked_by: framing round-trip now; notification parsing lands with the Go host worker/supervisor

vectors.name: observe_event_null_payload
vectors.note: payload may be any JSON value including null; the C client only requires presence (bbb_client.c:886-889)

vectors.name: invalid_observe_event_with_id
vectors.note: an observe.event carrying an id is a protocol error to the C client

vectors.name: rpc_disconnect_notification
vectors.note: rpc.disconnect is implemented only as this daemon-to-plugin notification (audit finding F-9); the daemon closes the connection after sending it
